title: 第十一章 陈入海
content_zh: “这事儿……”一心教的几位高层聚在一起，都是在龇牙咧嘴的吸冷气。都感觉这事儿太过于玄奇。“镇守者大殿，已经盯上了苏家。如果我们一心教想要吞了苏家财产，反而会出事。所以我们是拿不到的！”“大部分财产或者被侵吞，或者被瓜分；或者落入苏家其他人手里，然后这些人会带着财产消失得无影无踪。”“孙供奉的徒弟这一招……咳咳，倒是可行。”“是的，毕竟落入方彻手中，也等于是落在了一心教手里；方彻用这笔财产，不管是办什么事或者是提升自己，一些隐性好处，也等于是我们教的！”“那就这么办？”“好。”从这天晚上开始。突然间碧波城沸沸扬扬，全是方家方彻与苏家苏越的友情故事。一见如故，八拜之交，兄弟情深，相携相扶，义同生死，昭昭日月。苏越如何与方彻交好，而方彻为了苏越，做了什么事情等等，苏越病了，方彻千辛万苦寻找药材，找到了送过去，立即转头就走。豪迈地说：“你能好，比啥都强！我辛苦一番，又算得了什么？”苏越缺钱了，方彻立即倾囊而出的帮助，并且不惜欠债。并大笑说道：“区区钱财，岂能比得上你我兄弟情义？”苏越被人欺负了，方彻毅然拔剑而起，冲进战场，对着远远超出自己实力无数的对手说：“谁敢欺负我兄弟！？”于是被人打得腿都断了。却还是笑着说：“我方彻，见不得我兄弟被人欺负！便是死，又有何惧？义之所在，生死相随！刀山火海，不足惧也！”苏越要去做一件大事，临行郑重托付方彻：“兄弟，我此去吉凶难测，归期不定，家里一切，就拜托兄弟了。”并且专门写了字据，给方彻留作凭证。方彻郑重承诺：“自家兄弟，何言拜托二字？但凡我方彻还有一口气在，必然给你保住完整的苏家财产！”苏越失踪了，方彻听到噩耗，因此呕血，差点一病不起，悲愤的朝天大呼：“苍天呐……你还我兄弟！”无数人在争相称赞：方彻，真乃是兄弟之情的标杆，朋友之义的楷模。无数人在感叹：这一生能有方彻这样的朋友，真正是没有白活！有位诗人感动至极，专门为此写诗一首歌颂这美好的情义。谁言世上无兄弟？一诺生死不相弃；君放宽心且远去，此间浩然有正气。方家少年多情义，金兰之盟铭心底；为君留得青山在，待君归来再相聚！对于这种说法，碧波城传的沸沸扬扬；但是苏家人是不认的。“方彻和我们苏越没那么好的感情！”“我们家的人只是出去了，短时间没回来而已，又不是死了。”“出去一趟，一年半载不回来的人也有的是，为何就我们苏家反而例外了？”“方彻算什么东西？也能掌管左右我们苏家财产？”“绝对不行！”这种言论传出去，有一侠义人士义愤填膺，出来质问苏家：“你们这样说，可对得住人家方彻与苏越的感情吗？”苏家人非但不同意，反而聚集人手，对这位义士进行殴打，并且要取他性命。但，万万没想到的是，这位义士竟然是一位高手，大怒之下，仰天长啸：“如此玷污友情，如此侮辱兄弟，我王老三看不过去，今日便要替天行道了！”于是拔刀而起，将围攻他的苏家人杀的干干净净。然后更持刀闯入苏家大院，将满院苏家老小，杀的干干净净。将所有家丁仆役侍女丫鬟等，全部赶了出来。事后纵身而起，在半空中一声长啸，壮怀激烈的说道：“路见不平，拔刀相助！我乃是平湖王老三是也！”“我这人见不得蝇营狗苟，更见不得龌龊肮脏，今日冲动之下，着实杀的痛快！”哈哈大笑，一跃而起，消失在碧波城。等镇守者高手到来的时候，这位王老三已经无影无踪。从事情发生到大开杀戒到杀光苏家人，全部过程都不到半刻钟。突出了一个神速。苏家人就死光了。现在除了失踪的苏家人，就只剩下一个与苏越生死相交的方彻了！这事儿到了这个地步，所有人都懵逼了。镇守者大殿自然将方家列为重点，于是展开调查。结果……发现，方彻与苏越居然是真的感情，苏越有事没事，就到方家来找方彻，两人言谈甚欢……甚至，方家人怀疑苏越别有用心，其实是心怀鬼胎，但是方彻本人却从未怀疑过，一直坚定地认为，这就是他的好大哥！为了这个，甚至不惜和外公吵架，和舅舅闹翻，还顶撞母亲无数次……总而言之就一句话：方彻就认定了苏越！这就是他最好的朋友！这件事情，碧波城里还有不少可以作证的。甚至这些人还异口同声的说：方彻其实就是个傻逼，被苏越利用的……各种说法，甚嚣尘上。说啥的都有！越调查，越是糊涂。而方彻本人则是一副懵懂，热血少年的样子，反正，苏越就是我好大哥！财产我不在乎，但是属于我大哥的，谁也不能动！但是现在，苏家所有财产，所有产业都在停摆着……
content_en: "This matter..." Several senior leaders of Yixin Sect gathered together, grinning and sucking in the air-conditioning.They all felt that this was too mysterious."The Guardian Hall has set its sights on the Su family. If we wholeheartedly want to swallow up the Su family's property, something will happen. So we can't get it!" "Most of the property has been embezzled or divided up; or it has fallen into the hands of other people in the Su family, and then these people will disappear without a trace with their property." "Sun Chongfeng's.The apprentice's move... ahem, it works." "Yes, after all, if it falls into Fang Che's hands, it means it falls into the hands of the Yixin Cult;no matter what Fang Che does or improves himself, some hidden benefits are also from our teachings!" "That's it?" "Okay, starting from this night.Suddenly, Bibo City was abuzz with stories about the friendship between Fang Che of the Fang family and Su Yue of the Su family.We feel like old friends at first sight, become friends after eight worships, have a deep brotherly love, support each other, share life and death, and shine brightly to the sun and the moon.How did Su Yue become good friends with Fang Che, and what did Fang Che do for Su Yue? Su Yue was ill, and Fang Che went through a lot of trouble to find medicinal materials, found them, sent them over, and immediately turned around and left.He said boldly: "You can be better than anything else! What does it matter if I work hard?" Su Yue was short of money, and Fang Che immediately gave all his money to help, and he did not hesitate to owe money.And laughed and said: "How can a mere amount of money compare to the brotherhood between you and me?" Su Yue was bullied, Fang Che resolutely drew his sword, rushed into the battlefield, and said to opponents who were far beyond his own strength: "Who dares to bully my brother!?" So he was beaten until his legs were broken.But he still smiled and said: "I, Fang Che, don't want to see my brother being bullied! Even if it's death, what's the point of fear? The place of righteousness is life and death! There's nothing to be afraid of, mountains of swords and seas of fire!" Su Yue was about to do a big thing, and before leaving, he solemnly entrusted Fang Che with: "Brother, the good or bad of my departure is unpredictable, and my return date is uncertain. I leave everything to my brother." He also wrote a special note and left it to Fang Che as a certificate.Fang Che solemnly promised: "My brother, how can I say please? As long as I, Fang Che, am still alive, I will definitely keep the Su family's property intact for you!" Su Yue disappeared, and Fang Che heard the bad news, so he vomited blood and almost fell ill. He shouted to the sky in grief and anger: "Oh God... give me back my brother!" Countless people are vying to praise: Fang Che is really a benchmark of brotherhood and a model of friendship.Countless people are sighing: To have a friend like Fang Che in this life is really not in vain!A poet was so moved that he wrote a poem to praise this beautiful friendship.Who said there are no brothers in the world?I promise that we will never abandon each other in life or death. You can relax your mind and go away. There is great righteousness here.The young people of the Fang family are very affectionate, and their alliance with Jinlan is deep in their hearts; I have left the green hills for you, and we will meet again when you return!Regarding this statement, there is a lot of rumors in Bibo City; but the Su family does not admit it."Fang Che and our Su Yue don't have such a good relationship!" "Our family just went out and didn't come back for a short time. They are not dead." "There are many people who go out and don't come back for a year and a half. Why is our Su family an exception?" "Who is Fang Che? He can also control us.The property of the Su family?" "Absolutely not!" When word of this came out, a chivalrous man was filled with indignation and came out to question the Su family: "Do you think this is fair to the feelings of Fang Che and Su Yue?" The Su family not only disagreed, but instead gathered people to beat the righteous man and even take his life.However, what I never expected was that this righteous man turned out to be a master. In anger, he looked up to the sky and screamed: "I, Wang Lao San, can't bear to see such a stain on friendship and such insult to brothers. I will do justice for heaven today!" So he drew his sword and killed all the Su family members who besieged him.Then he broke into the Su family's courtyard with a knife and killed everyone in the Su family's courtyard.All the servants, servants, maids, maids, etc. were all driven out.Afterwards, he jumped up, let out a long roar in the air, and said fiercely: "When the road is rough, draw your sword to help! I am the third king of Pinghu!" "I don't want to be a fool, let alone a dirty person. Today, I was so impulsive that I really enjoyed killing!" He laughed loudly, jumped up, and disappeared into Bibo City.By the time the guardian master arrived, Wang Laosan had disappeared without a trace.From the incident to the killing spree to killing all the Su family members, the entire process took less than half a quarter of an hour.Highlights a divine speed.Everyone in the Su family died.Now apart from the missing Su family, there is only one Fang Che who has a life-and-death relationship with Su Yue!This matter has reached this point, and everyone is confused.The Guardian Hall naturally prioritized the Fang family and launched an investigation.As a result... it was discovered that Fang Che and Su Yue actually had a real relationship. Su Yue came to Fang Che's house to find Fang Che when he had something to do. The two talked happily... The Fang family even suspected that Su Yue had ulterior motives and was actually harboring evil intentions. However, Fang Che himself never doubted it and always firmly believed that this was his good big brother!For this reason, he even quarreled with his grandfather, fell out with his uncle, and contradicted his mother countless times... In short, in one sentence: Fang Che recognized Su Yue!This is his best friend!There are many people in Bibo City who can testify to this matter.These people even said in unison: Fang Che was actually an idiot and was taken advantage of by Su Yue... Various theories were rampant.You can say anything!The more I investigate, the more confused I become.Fang Che himself looks like an ignorant and passionate young man. Anyway, Su Yue is my good big brother!I don't care about property, but no one can touch what belongs to my eldest brother!But now, all the property and industries of the Su family are at a standstill...
